findings.detail: bvn length: handler enforces exactly 10 characters, spec requires exactly 11 (minLength 11, maxLength 11)
findings.evidence: if (!req.body || String(req.body.bvn || "").length !== 10) { — the handler accepts a bvn of length 10 and rejects a bvn of length 11, while the spec constrains bvn to minLength 11 / maxLength 11 (the handler's own error message, "bvn must be 11 digits", also contradicts the check) (verified: {"success":false,"code":"invalid_bvn","message":"bvn must be 11 digits"})
